airplane.guidance: Describe overhead aircraft footprint cues: fuselage, wings, tail, nose direction, and placement on airport pavement. Avoid ground-view, material, shadow, or runway-marking cues.
valid_examples: symmetric wingspan attached to a narrow fuselage
cross-shaped aircraft footprint on open apron pavement
tail-like rear shape behind an elongated body
invalid_examples: cockpit window visible from the front
linear runway markings aligned with landing strip

airport.guidance: Describe airport-scale overhead layout: long runway strips, taxiway curves, apron fields, terminal blocks, and large connected pavement systems. Avoid generic transportation-complex wording.
valid_examples: long runway strip connected to curved taxiways
broad apron field adjacent to terminal blocks
airport-scale pavement network with multiple runway segments
invalid_examples: large transportation complex with sparse buildings

baseballfield.guidance: Describe baseball-field geometry visible from above: diamond infield, fan-shaped outfield, curved boundary, and infield/outfield contrast.
valid_examples: diamond infield embedded in fan-shaped outfield
curved outfield boundary around a brown infield
sports field organized around a central diamond
invalid_examples: generic green field with bright markings

basketballcourt.guidance: Describe small rectangular court geometry: compact paved rectangle, paired court markings, and location within sports or school grounds.
valid_examples: small rectangular court with paired painted key areas
compact paved sports rectangle inside a larger recreation area
parallel court markings within a bounded rectangular surface
invalid_examples: tennis court group with net-divided long rectangles
parking lot stripes without court boundary

bridge.guidance: Describe overhead bridge structure: narrow linear span crossing water, roads, or valleys, with approach roads aligned to the span.
valid_examples: narrow linear span crossing a river channel
road bridge connecting two land edges over water
straight elevated segment with aligned approach roads

chimney.guidance: Describe chimney as a tall industrial stack seen from above: small circular or narrow vertical footprint, nearby industrial buildings, and compact shadow-adjacent stack layout. Avoid shadow-only cues.
valid_examples: small circular stack footprint beside industrial buildings
narrow chimney base within a factory compound
isolated stack point attached to rectangular plant structures
invalid_examples: long shadow cast across a roof

dam.guidance: Describe dam layout: broad linear barrier across water, reservoir edge, spillway-like geometric structure, and road or wall crossing a river valley.
valid_examples: wide linear barrier separating reservoir water from downstream channel
curved concrete wall across a river valley
spillway-like stepped structure attached to water body

expressway service area.guidance: Describe highway-side rest-area layout only: paved roadside compounds, parking blocks, access ramps, road-connected asphalt zones, and separation from main expressway carriageway. Ignore amenities and human facilities.
valid_examples: paved rest-area compound beside expressway lanes
parking blocks connected by curved access ramps
open paved service zone separated from main carriageway
invalid_examples: group of service buildings with clear signage
paved zone with distinct geometric patterns

expressway toll station.guidance: Describe toll-plaza geometry: lane expansion, transverse canopy band, repeated booths, and highway lanes passing through a checkpoint.
valid_examples: widened expressway segment with parallel toll lanes
transverse canopy band crossing highway lanes
repeated small booths aligned across a road corridor

golffield.guidance: Describe golf-course layout: large landscaped fairways, putting greens, sand bunkers, curved paths, and repeated smooth grass corridors.
valid_examples: curving fairway corridors with small bright sand bunkers
multiple green patches connected by narrow cart paths
large landscaped course with irregular fairway shapes

groundtrackfield.guidance: Describe athletics track field: oval running track, inner field, lane rings, and stadium-like sports-ground layout without relying on spectator stands.
valid_examples: oval running track enclosing a central field
elliptical lane rings around green sports ground
red or dark oval track boundary with inner rectangle

harbor.guidance: Describe harbor layout: water-adjacent dock structures, piers, quay lines, moored ships, and sheltered basin geometry.
valid_examples: water basin lined with straight quay edges
multiple piers extending into harbor water
cluster of moored ships along dock structures
invalid_examples: single ship hull on open water

overpass.guidance: Describe road overpass geometry: elevated road segment crossing another road, interchange ramps, and layered road intersections.
valid_examples: elevated road segment crossing perpendicular lanes
curved ramp structure within a road interchange
layered highway crossing with visible approach roads

ship.guidance: Describe ship footprint on water: elongated hull-like object, pointed ends, wake-adjacent placement, and contrast against water. Avoid harbor-level dock layout.
valid_examples: elongated hull-shaped object surrounded by water
bright narrow ship footprint with pointed bow-like end
isolated vessel shape separated from dock structures

stadium.guidance: Describe stadium footprint: large oval or rectangular sports venue, surrounding stands, enclosed field, and ring-like structure.
valid_examples: large oval stadium ring enclosing a sports field
rectangular arena footprint with surrounding stands
enclosed field inside a large built seating structure
invalid_examples: simple oval running track without stands

storagetank.guidance: Describe storage tanks by stable overhead footprint: circular tank roofs, repeated round structures, industrial compound layout, and regular spacing. Avoid material, liquid, reflection, or shadow claims.
valid_examples: round tank roofs arranged in an industrial compound
regular grid of circular storage structures
large circular footprint separated from rectangular buildings
invalid_examples: bright reflection spots indicating liquid presence
consistent dark shadows under cylindrical bodies

tenniscourt.guidance: Describe tennis-court geometry: long narrow rectangular courts, central net line, paired court markings, and repeated court groups.
valid_examples: long rectangular court split by a central net line
paired tennis courts with repeated painted boundaries
parallel narrow sports rectangles grouped side by side

trainstation.guidance: Describe train station layout: parallel rail tracks, elongated platform structures, station building aligned with tracks, and rail-yard geometry.
valid_examples: parallel rail tracks flanking long platform strips
elongated station building aligned beside rail corridors
multiple track lines converging near platform structures

vehicle.guidance: Describe vehicles as small compact objects on roads, parking lots, or paved areas. Use size, rectangular footprint, rows, and road/parking context. Avoid shadows, vegetation, texture patches, or tire-track speculation.
valid_examples: small compact rectangular objects aligned along road edges
rows of vehicle-sized rectangles in parking areas
tiny bright or dark objects much smaller than nearby buildings
invalid_examples: patch of uniform gray tones surrounded by vegetation
series of elongated shadows cast by parked cars
row of parallel lines indicating tire tracks

windmill.guidance: Describe windmills by overhead turbine layout: central tower point, radial blades, isolated placement in open land, and regular turbine spacing.
valid_examples: radial blade pattern around a central tower point
isolated wind turbine footprint on open terrain
regularly spaced turbines with three-blade shapes
